mesh.file: 02_人体骨骼晶格肌肉方案/输出/integration_review/s1_series_elbow/FJ1486_interface_relief_TPU.obj

scope: Every tenth loaded sample plus peak tension and peak bend-load frames. At bends above 1 N, probe the load direction and two directions offset by 20 degrees up to 5 mm from the steel centreline. First stock is the radial thickness of the first contiguous material interval and is a lower bound if that interval extends past the ray. Interpolated TPU geometry and uniform distal tension; this is not a contact or strength solution.
